title: Abhyankar base change for a finite DVR extension with given tame bounds
statement: Let $B$ and $A$ be DVR domains [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], and give $A$ a finite faithful $B$-algebra structure. Let $n>0$ be a unit in $B$ and assume $\mathfrak m_B A=\mathfrak m_A^n$. Let $E/\operatorname{Frac}(B)$ be finite separable [def-pc-field-extension, def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension], with its composite $B$-algebra structure, and let $C=\operatorname{integralClosure}_B(E)$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure]. Assume for every prime $R$ of $C$ above $\mathfrak m_B$ that both its ramification index and residue degree divide $n$. For every maximal ideal $P$ of $D=E\otimes_B A$, give $F=D/P$ its $A$-algebra structure by the right tensor inclusion and put $S=\operatorname{integralClosure}_A(F)$. Assume $S$ is finite as an $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Then for every prime ideal $Q$ of $S$ contracting to $\mathfrak m_A$, the map $A\to S_Q$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is formally unramified: its module of relative Kahler differentials is zero.

source.place: Tags 0BRM (Abhyankar lemma), 09E7 (adically formally smooth DVR criterion), 00UW and 02FM (local unramified criterion).

proof.text: Apply the maximal-ideal consequence of tame base change to the chosen tensor quotient and Q, obtaining m_A S_Q = m_(S_Q). This equality implies that the canonical algebra map A -> S_Q is local by IsLocalRing.local_hom_TFAE.
Apply the residue-separability consequence of tame base change with this local-hom proof, obtaining separability of the induced extension of local residue fields.

The assumed finite A-module structure on S implies finite type. Localization gives an essentially finite type A-algebra S_Q by Algebra.EssFiniteType.comp. Apply Algebra.FormallyUnramified.of_map_maximalIdeal (Stacks 02FM) to the maximal-ideal equality and residue separability.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0BRM and 09E7, reduced to their maximal-ideal and residue-field consequences; final glue is Mathlib.RingTheory.Unramified.LocalRing, Tag 02FM.

lean.statement:
theorem dvr_tame_tensor_factor_formallyUnramified
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    (n : ℕ) (hnpos : 0 < n) (hn : IsUnit (n : B))
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    [Algebra B A] [Module.Finite B A] [FaithfulSMul B A]
    (hindex : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).map (algebraMap B A) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A ^ n)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (FractionRing B) E]
    (hE : FiniteDimensional (FractionRing B) E ∧ Algebra.IsSeparable (FractionRing B) E) :
    letI : Algebra B E :=
      ((algebraMap (FractionRing B) E).comp (algebraMap B (FractionRing B))).toAlgebra
    let C := integralClosure B E
    (∀ (R : Ideal C) (hR : R.IsPrime),
      letI := hR
      R.comap (algebraMap B C) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B →
        R.ramificationIdx B ∣ n ∧ R.inertiaDeg B ∣ n) →
    let D := E ⊗[B] A
    ∀ (P : Ideal D) (hP : P.IsMaximal),
    let := hP
    let F := D ⧸ P
    let alpha : A →+* F := (Ideal.Quotient.mk P).comp
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[B] D).toRingHom
    letI := alpha.toAlgebra
    let S := integralClosure A F
    Module.Finite A S →
    ∀ (Q : Ideal S) (hQ : Q.IsPrime),
    let := hQ
    Q.comap (algebraMap A S) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A →
      Algebra.FormallyUnramified A (Localization.AtPrime Q)
